text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain can feel rewarding, but my cost basis and realized profit do not determine whether a trade is sensible; I should decide based on future prospects, goals, and risk.","I made no trades during several periods of falling prices, and the later rebound reinforced that short-term moves are unpredictable; I should avoid impulsive reactions to daily account checks.","Repeatedly trimming winners and then buying every holding back can undermine a consistent plan; I should set target allocations and rebalance deliberately while preserving diversification."]}
